parts.official_mark_scheme_text: State that the position vector of \(M\) is \(3\mathbf i+\mathbf j\). B1. Use a correct method to find the position vector of \(N\). M1. Obtain \(\frac{10}{3}\mathbf i+2\mathbf j+2\mathbf k\). A1. Use a correct method to form an equation for \(MN\). M1. Obtain a correct answer in any form, e.g. \(\mathbf r=3\mathbf i+\mathbf j+\lambda(\frac13\mathbf i+\mathbf j+2\mathbf k)\). A1. Total [5].

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: State or imply \(\mathbf r=\mu(2\mathbf i+2\mathbf j+3\mathbf k)\) as the equation for \(OB\). B1. Equate sufficient components of \(MN\) and \(OB\) and solve for \(\lambda\) or \(\mu\). M1. Obtain \(\lambda=3\) or \(\mu=2\), and position vector \(4\mathbf i+4\mathbf j+6\mathbf k\) for \(P\). A1. Total [3].
